features.name: Managed Offering
features.description: A managed, zero-ops offering of the catalog exists, so teams can adopt it without operating the catalog service themselves

features.name: Serves Own Tables via IRC
features.description: Serves its own Iceberg tables to external engines over the Iceberg REST Catalog (IRC) API, read and write, with catalog-vended short-lived credentials

features.name: R/W Foreign Tables via IRC
features.description: Reads and writes individual foreign Iceberg tables governed by an external catalog over IRC using spec-compliant vended credentials. Requires a bundled query engine to execute, so self-hosted OSS catalogs without one score as not supported (BYO compute)

features.name: Federation (Catalog Broker)
features.description: Acts as a meta-catalog: an IRC client to multiple external catalogs, cataloguing their tables and vending short-lived read/write credentials over IRC to arbitrary incoming engines (a catalog of catalogs). Proprietary brokering that needs a persistent, broadly-scoped storage credential does not count

features.name: Multi-Engine & Multi-Cloud
features.description: Broad engine compatibility (Spark, Flink, Trino, DuckDB, PyIceberg and more) and multi-cloud storage support, rather than a single vendor's stack

features.name: Governance & Credential Vending
features.description: Fine-grained governance (RBAC, masking, row/column policies) plus spec-compliant credential vending: short-lived, path-scoped credentials issued by the catalog
